text:
Elaine: Heads up — onboarding playbook automation missed scheduled sends for the last 36h. noticed in weekly health sweep. Some accounts didn't get activation emails or tasks.
cs-bot: playbook-run failed 3 times: onboarding_flow_v2 — error: timezone parsing error (America/Clar). logs: /var/logs/playbooks/197765.log
Sam: ugh. i've seen this before — cron/UTC mismatch after DST patch. suspect scheduler config rolled back.
Marco: is this only prod? sandbox ok?
Elaine: only prod. sandbox runs looked fine. impact ~120 accounts at high touch — flagged as renewal risk if onboarding stalls.
Sam: quick mitigation: force scheduler to UTC and restart. i'll push in 5.
Jordan: after restart can we backfill the missed steps? need the query for accounts that didn't receive 'welcome' task.
Sam: yes. backfill command:
```
python tools/backfill_playbook.py --playbook onboarding_flow_v2 --since 2025-03-01 --quiet
```
Sam: i'll run it after restart and post progress.
Elaine: TY. pls include a note in healthscore so CSMs don't miss renewals.
Marco: also let's add alert for missing sends >12h in automation monitoring.
Sam: adding alert now: prom rule + slack webhook. will PR in infra-playbooks.
cs-bot: automation alert created: rule_id=pb_missing_sends_hightouch. linked to #incidents
Jordan: i'll coordinate with CS ops to message affected accounts after backfill. template below:
"Hi <first_name>, we noticed an issue with onboarding messages — you may have missed some steps. We've re-sent them and your onboarding timeline is unchanged. Ping if anything looks off."
Elaine: Perfect. ETA for backfill?
Sam: started 10:12 UTC, ~2m/account — estimating 20m. will update when done.
Sam: backfill complete. 128 accounts reprocessed. 0 errors. logs: s3://redwood-logs/backfill/1977654321.log
Elaine: great. marking playbook as stable for now. follow-up: postmortem + change for scheduler config rolling back to be prevented.
Marco: +1. thanks all :thumbsup:
